56: A petty criminal fakes insanity to serve his sentence in a mental ward rather than prison. He soon finds himself as a leader to the other patients—and an enemy to the cruel, domineering nurse who runs the ward.
In this clean, orderly, disciplined world, who needs guys like McMurphy? Everybody.
312: New York comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.
568: In the highlands of Scotland in the 1700s, Rob Roy tries to lead his small town to a better future, by borrowing money from the local nobility to buy cattle to herd to market. When the money is stolen, Rob is forced into a Robin Hood lifestyle to defend his family and honour.
Honor made him a man. Courage made him a hero. History made him a legend.
824: A deadpan young man obsessed with death meets an eccentric septuagenarian who teaches him to live life to the fullest.
They were meant to be. But exactly what they were meant to be is not quite clear.
1080: As the railroad builders advance unstoppably through the Arizona desert on their way to the sea, Jill arrives in the small town of Flagstone with the intention of starting a new life.
There were three men in her life. One to take her… one to love her —and one to kill her.
1336: An aging publisher becomes a demon wolf and, with this newfound youthful vigor, fights to keep his job.
1592: When a Chinese rebel murders Chon's estranged father and escapes to England, Chon and Roy make their way to London with revenge on their minds.
A Royal Kick In The Arse
1848: A vacuum repairman moonlights as a street musician and hopes for his big break. The pair decide to collaborate, and the songs that they compose reflect the story of their blossoming love.
How often do you find the right person?
2104: An impressionable teenage girl from a dead-end town and her older greaser boyfriend embark on a killing spree in the South Dakota badlands.
In 1959 a lot of people were killing time. Kit and Holly were killing people.

Frank Galvin has one last chance to do something right.
2616: Our favourite police men are called together to deal with a gang who rob banks and jewelers. Using their various talents as well as their extraordinary luck, the crooks stand no chance against our men and women in blue.
The Grads are going undercover in the city to unmask the mastermind of crime.
2872: Based on Wes Craven's 1977 suspenseful cult classic, The Hills Have Eyes is the story of a family road trip that goes terrifyingly awry when the travelers become stranded in a government atomic zone. 3128: Navy SEAL Shane Wolfe is handed a new assignment: Protect the five Plummer kids from enemies of their recently deceased father -- a government scientist whose top-secret experiment remains hidden in the kids' house.

3640: Kai—an outcast—joins Oishi, the leader of 47 outcast samurai.  Together they seek vengeance upon the treacherous overlord who killed their master and banished their kind. For courage. For loyalty. For honor.
3896: Eddie is a New York limo driver and a fanatical follower of the New York Knicks professional basketball team. The team is struggling with a mediocre record when, in mid-season, "Wild Bill" Burgess, the new owner, as a public relations gimmick, stages an 'honorary coach' contest, which Eddie wins. The fans love it, so "Wild Bill" fires the coach and hires her. She takes the bunch of overpaid prima
The newest coach in the NBA has got the Knicks right where she wants them.
4152: After being threatened during a confession, a good-natured priest must battle the dark forces closing in around him.
Killing a priest on a Sunday. That’ll be a good one.
4664: A 14th century Crusader returns with his comrade to a homeland devastated by the Black Plague. The Church commands the two knights to transport a witch to a remote abbey, where monks will perform a ritual in hopes of ending the pestilence.
Not all souls can be saved.
4920: A newly-released prison gangster is forced by the leaders of his gang to orchestrate a major crime with a brutal rival gang on the streets of Southern California.
Some criminals are made in prison
5176: A new drug promises out-of-body experiences, but users are coming back changed forever, and an otherworldly invasion of Earth is underway.
Just so you know... they're sorry for anything that's about to happen.
5432: A modern-day take on the "Beauty and the Beast" tale where a New York teen is transformed into a hideous monster in order to find true love.
5688: This time around, Chucky and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then the horror goes Hollywood as Chucky unleashes his own brand of murderous mayhem!
5944: In a totalitarian future society, a man whose daily work is rewriting history tries to rebel by falling in love.
Will ecstasy be a crime... in the terrifying world of the future? Amazing wonders of tomorrow! Nothing like it ever filmed! From the startling George Orwell novel!
Winston Smith of the Outer Party
6200: The film is about an unemployed banker, Henri Verdoux, and his sociopathic methods of attaining income. While being both loyal and competent in his work, Verdoux has been laid-off. 6456: TV cameraman Harry Hinkle is injured while filming a football game. Harry's similarly-minded ex-wife suddenly reappears in an attempt to rekindle their relationship.
Is he a spy? A security risk? Is he unfaithful? Or is he a nice, normal shnook - out to make a million bucks by sheer accident!
6712: Ren MacCormack is transplanted from Boston to the small southern town of Bomont where loud music and dancing are prohibited. Not one to bow to the status quo, Ren challenges the ban, revitalizing the town and falling in love with the minister’s troubled daughter Ariel in the process.
There comes a time to cut loose
6968: Real zombies arrive and terrorize the crew of a zombie film being shot in an abandoned warehouse, said to be the site of military experiments on humans.
7224: Trapped on her family’s isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter and overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for a glamorous life like she’s seen in the movies, Pearl’s ambitions, temptations, and repressions collide.

The psychic comedy that's out of its mind.
7736: In the Deep South of the 1930s, Rose is taken in by the Hillyer family to serve as housemaid so that she can avoid falling into a life of prostitution. Her appearence and personality is such that all men fall for her, and she knows it. She can't help herself from getting into trouble with men.
Innocence has never been so seductive.
7992: Ten-year-old Laure isn't like most girls. She prefers football to dolls and sweaters to dresses. When Laure and her family move to a new neighbourhood, local girl Lisa mistakes Laure for a boy. There's a new kid in town.
8248: Newlyweds Nick and Suzanne decide to move to the suburbs to provide a better life for their two kids. But their idea of a dream home is disturbed by a contractor with a bizarre approach to business.
New house. New family. What could possibly go wrong?
8504: In 1943, a childless couple, the Čížeks, decide to hide a Jewish refugee, David Wiener, the son of Čížek's former employer, in the secret pantry of their apartment. His personal situation is greatly complicated by the approaching end of the war, when he faces danger from both the Germans and his "honest" fellow Czechs...

In marriage no one can hear you scream.

Can a newfound urgency help these dads draw closer to God... and to their children?

10040: An American scholar in Greece sets about improving the local prostitute with whom he is infatuated.
10296: During the Blitz of World War II, a female screenwriter works on a film celebrating England's resilience as a way to buoy a weary populace's spirits. In the fight for freedom everyone played a part.
10808: In the late 1940s, a murderous couple known as the 'The Lonely Hearts Killers' kills close to a dozen people. Two detectives try to nab the duo who find their targets via the personals in the paper.

Never mess with a man's dog.

The most powerful weapon is the truth.

Friendship pulled them together. Love tore them apart.

Then they get into real trouble when one after the other of their female colleagues is kidnapped.
12856: Disgusted with the policies of King Charles I, Oliver Cromwell plans to take his family to the New World. But on the eve of their departure, Cromwell is drawn into the tangled web of religion and politics that will result in the English Civil War.
13112: When her idolized twin sister Audrey dies in a car accident, Laurel decides to take her place. But, as she eases into the life she has always wanted, she must decide between continuing the lie or revealing herself.
13624: The territorial governor asks the Lone Ranger to investigate mysterious raids on settlers by Indians who ride with saddles. Wealthy rancher Reese Kilgore wants to mine silver on Spirit Mountain which is sacred to the Indians.
The Lone Ranger thunders to the motion picture screen!

14136: Six different writers wrote a scene each of this romantic comedy featuring the marriage and turbulent relationship of Joseph and Sarah, with Joseph's best friend Frank trying hard to cope with letting the love of his life marry his best friend.
14392: A two-bit promoter tries to take a women's wrestling team to the top.
The California Dolls and their best friend Harry...Together they're going for...All The Marbles
14648: An aging agent is called back by "the Company" to run a hostage trade of a Soviet spy for an American agent.
You can't judge a man by the company that keeps him!

Fists and fun fly fast and furious when the Dragon Lord fights to save his nation's treasure.

Yesterday they fought each other – today they fight together in a dead end canyon called Diablo!

(Storyville)
16696: An artist grows distant from his new wife as an irrational fear of premature burial consumes him.
16952: A social misfit, Willard is made fun of by his co-workers, and squeezed out of the company started by his deceased father by his boss. This is Willard and his friend Ben. Ben will do anything for Willard.
17208: Wanting to earn fame and fortune, a small time lawyer files a PIL for an infamous hit-and-run, and thus learns what it really is like to be a lawyer.
17464: Her mother in Kenya, 13-year-old Melanie spends her summer vacation at a strict diet camp set in the Austrian countryside. Between workouts and nutrition classes, pillow fights and first cigarettes, she falls in love with a doctor 40 years her senior.
17976: Laos. In a land ravaged by war and exploitation, a boy whose family believe he is cursed must redeem himself by taking part in a dangerous rocket competition.

18744: A band of misfit teenagers, along with a film studio security guard, must recapture escaped hobgoblins with the ability to make people live out their wildest fantasies.
Be careful what you wish for... you just might get it!
19000: The true story of Neil and Ivan McCormick, two Irish brothers who attempt to become rock stars but can only look on as their high school friends U2 become the biggest band in the world.
19256: Two rival "brothers-in-law" make a bet that they can stop smoking for 2 weeks. But, it's just not that easy...
They said they'd do it.Unfortunately, they did!
19512: A Romanian police officer teams up with a small crew of bank robbers to pull off a heist by convincing everyone at the scene of the crime that they are only filming a movie.
19768: Both a journalist and a documentary filmmaker chase the story of a murder and its prime suspect.
Forget the truth, find the story.
20024: When eight male cadets are left behind at an isolated military high school, the greatest romantic drama ever written seeps out of the classroom and permeates their lives.
Love goes toward love as schoolboys from their books.
20536: A couple on holiday on a remote South Pacific island awaken one morning with a hang over and no recollection of what transpired. When playing back a video of the previous night, they see they participated in a local ritual that somehow ends with him murdering her.

This is a story about love and money… but actually about love for money
21048: Artem Kolchin was one of many, but he wanted glory. And he has chosen the way: he became the boxer. Now Artem the applicant for a champion title, fighter, known worldwide as Great White Hope. But the main fight in his life has not gone how he expected...

They also have to avoid the poachers that injured their alien friend, and now seem to be stalking them all.

They've got the money… They've got each other… Now They've got to survive!

Gee it's great to be together at last on another fellows honeymoon!

There hasn't been a Christmas tree like this for 100 years.

What else you gonna do on a Saturday?

One man. One job. One hell of a night.

Anne, la mère de Jeanne adolescente
24632: Following the death of their patriarch Gus, the Portokalos family travels to Greece for a family reunion, and to deliver Gus' journal to his old friends.
It’s more than a journey. It’s more than a promise. It’s the event that brings everyone together.
24888: A group of friends stranded near a desolate cornfield find shelter in an old farmhouse, though they soon discover the dwelling is the center of a supernatural ritual.
25144: An underprivileged hairdresser becomes the game changer in a local body election in a village where caste politics rules the roost. Will he be able to bring some changes to people's lives?

The players who inspired a generation.
25656: Arnab tries to help Ruksahana, who is found under mysterious circumstances in a house. He lets her stay at his home until he discovers something strange about her.
25912: When his beloved dog goes missing, a young man embarks on an incredible search with his parents to find him and give him life-saving medication.
To find what's lost, a father and son will do the impossible.
26168: When a woman is found dead with her throat torn out, the local villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.

A mysterious stranger with healing powers arrives in a small village.
27192: Manasa and Chaitanya are engaged to be married, but when Chaitanya quits his job, will the wedding go through?

In an impossible time, it takes impossible courage.

A high-flying family adventure filled with friendship and love.
28216: The peaceful cohabitation of two 30-something bachelors is disrupted when they both fall in love with the charming young woman who moves in with them.
28472: A widower and two of his sons become infatuated by their beautiful housekeeper, and all three set out to seduce her using their own unique methods.
Wasn't that thoughtful of mother — to hire a maid like Angela, and then die.
28728: A young woman with dreams of being a dancer moves to Hollywood with her draft-dodging boyfriend. While the man is forced to take a job as a janitor, his girlfriend enters the glamour of go-go dancing and the criminal world of drug trafficking.
The glitz and glamor of being a big time Hollywood Go-Go dancer looked good from a distance, but up-close it was another story...this story
28984: Mannar Mannan, an ordinary villager, decides to call himself the president of the country and starts fighting against the injustices he comes across in his society. What's his agenda?

Spence has a girlfriend from hell, and Hogan just wants to start his life. As luck would have it, these two young men are presented with an opportunity, and develop a club of young men devoted to older women, whom they call “Cougars.”
29496: Story of the 1974 coup that overthrew the right-wing Portuguese dictatorship--which continued the fascist policies of long-time dictator Antonio Salazar--and of two young army captains who were involved in it.
29752: When Henry fails yet again to hand in his homework for the umpteenth time, he has no idea that this will set off a chain of events which will see him forming an unlikely alliance with Moody Margaret, the infuriating girl next door, and his irritating little brother Perfect Peter, outwitting corrupt school Inspectors and toppling an evil Headmaster, winning a talent contest and facing his ultimate nemesis with no way out.
30008: The sequel carries forward the tale of power and revenge which exploded in Rakht Charitra 1. Surya swears vengeance against Pratap after his family is wiped out in a bomb attack and Pratap is hell bent on decimating his enemy, even if it means separating ways with his mentor and political veteran, Shivaji.
30520: After a near-fatal car accident, Sam wakes to discover he is trapped in an abandoned hospital by mysterious and sinister forces that have no intention of letting him leave…
30776: Teens in a small conservative town are turned into evil demons thanks to the music of the titular heavy metal band.
Live for one night only... that's all they ever need.

31288: When an inexperienced park ranger finds a dead body under mysterious circumstances on a remote mountain trail, she must guard it overnight until authorities can arrive, forcing her to confront some of her deepest, darkest fears.

31800: A group of teenagers at a party find themselves being stalked by a maniacal killer in a Santa Claus costume.

When a client is killed by his wife in their establishment, they find a suitcase with drugs.

If at first you don't succeed...

The US government puts the finger on the United Nations' enemies

33848: Stan and Ollie travel with a band of 18th-century Gypsies holding a nobleman's daughter.
